scripts.text:
[Shep]
Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower?
It's extremely dangerous so you need to be at least ^4d4dffLevel 130^000000.

[Shep]
Will you come back when you get stronger?
You know what I mean right?

[Shep]
You want to explore again so soon?
Your body needs to recover from the time traveling.

[Shep]
Take a rest day and come back tomorrow.!
You understand?

[Shep]
Have you rested long enough?
I am scheduled to explore today!
I have always been waiting for a member of the expedition!

!- Notice -!
You can now re-enter the Devil's Tower.

[Shep]
So time and space seem to have converged there?
I'm amazed that time travel is possible.

[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!

[Shep]
Oh, you are back so soon...
Ok, I see what happened.

[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!

[Shep]
Oh, you are back.
Let me see... you mean this tower has a passage to connect to the demon world.

[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!

[Shep]
Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower? I have been waiting for someone like you!

[Shep]
Finally, someone to share the mysteries of the tower for me.
No one has been volunteering up this point so I was getting worried.

[Shep]
Please report anything you find in the tower to me.
The better the info~ the better the zeny I'll pay you!

[Shep]
That Laphine scholar over there will open up the dimensional gap with this time device.
It is still unstable so your time for exploring will be limited.

[Shep]
If you are unexpectedly bounced back to here again, you should return quickly.
If you do you may or may not be able to re-enter depending on how fast you are.

[Shep]
But if you run out of time, the access to the tower will disappear.
So do you want to volunteer?
Volunteer
No Thanks

[Shep]
Oh that's too bad
There is nothing I can do I guess.
I'll just find someone else...

[Shep]
Thank you.
Okay, gather your party and remember to report to me what you find.

[Shep]
^4d4dffExploring time limit is for your safety^000000!

[Shep]
You seem to be late.
You took an extraordinarily long time.
.....
I can't use any of your info.

[Shep]
There is nothing we can do .
There's always opportunities for other expeditions.

[Shep]
First of all, you need to reserve a queue at the gate.
The Laphine Scholar Artie will reserve your queue for you.

[Shep]
Time is limited because the dimensional gap is still unstable.
Make your exploration short and sweet.

[Shep]
Rewards will be different depending on your time.
Good luck!
Trust me!
Cancel my reservation

[Shep]
I believe that you can manage under these restrictions.
I believe in you!

[Shep]
You seem to be tired of exploring.
^4d4dffIf you cancel now. You will be able to challenge one day after.^000000
Is that okay?
Yes Cancel.
Wait, don't cancel!

[Shep]
Ok, I won't cancel.

[Shep]
Really.
then, come back tomorrow.

[Shep]
Really?
After listening to all this explanation?

[Artie]
let's have fun since we just left bifrost.
No?
you are applying as a volunteer?
You'd better gather a party for this expedition.

[Artie]
Don't take any unncessary risks, okay?

[Artie]
Bring the Expedition Chief.
Devil's Tower is not a place to visit alone.
Bring the manager.

[Artie]
You have already entered by connecting it.
Connect to the space again? I can not do that.

[Artie]
Hrm... It is difficult to connect to unless it is an appointed exploration time.
Not to mention dangerous as well.

[Artie]
Are you a volunteer to explore the Devil's Tower?
Do you want me to activate the Dimensional Device?

[Artie]
Decide quickly because you only have a finite amount of time in there.
Yes, activate the device.
Wait for a minute.

[Artie]
Your time to explore is dwindling.
Time is very important.
What are you waiting for?

[Artie]
The Dimensional Device is activated.
If you're lucky, you can get through this quickly.
I look forward to hearing good news.

[Artie]
Hey, Hey
It is difficult to send to you through the device right now.
We should stop exploring today and let's go again another day.

[Artie]
Look, I am sorry but it is not allowed to enter except during the allowed time, Devil's Tower is dangerous.

[Artie]
Yes, this is the Dimensional Device.
It is used to travel time.
It will be difficult to enter again if you leave.

[Artie]
Don't worry though, I'm a genius scholar~
Anyway, ready to enter?
Enter the device.
Stop.

[Artie]
Right.
It seems like quite a long time has passed since you activated the device. Am I right?
An unknown error occurred.

[Shep]
The Dimensional Device needs to be activated first before entering.
It doesn't seem to be activated yet.

[Shep]
Please get a permission to activate it by talking to the Magic Scholar Artie.

[Artie]
Exploring Devil's Tower will be permitted only for expeditions in parties.
Make sure you are ready.

[Officer Heim]
Who brought you all here?
I will talk to a representative.

[Officer Heim]
Back up soldiers? So why are you just standing there?
Right now?

[Healer Fama]
Commander please help me. I can't do it by myself~!

[Officer Heim]
Do you hear that?
Help Fama take care of the injured soldiers.
Fama will give you first aid-kits, use it to help the injured people.

[Officer Heim]
It is priority to treat the injured soldiers by assisting Fama.
Please do your best even if the environment is the worst.

[Officer Heim]
Luckily, no one is dead yet.
I do not want to see my soldiers die.

[Healer Fama]
Please cure the injured with this first aid kit.
It's not difficult. Just follow the instructions.

[Healer Fama]
We are low on supplies. So I will give them once at a time.
Sorry, please request again if you run out.

[Healer Fama]
Sorry... procurement is not good right now so I can only provide one first-aid kit at a time.
Please request again if you run out.

[Healer Fama]
Huh... Okay, we can take a break now.
Thank you very much!
I need 1 first-aid-kit to treat the injured soldier.

This soldier has lost consciousness and groaning.
Should I use the first-aid kit?
Use first-aid kit.
Observe condition.
You decide to observe the condition of the injured soldier more.
You administer the first-aid-kit to the soldier.
It worked.

[Injured soldiers]
whew.. it seems to be okay now.
Thank you.

[Injured soldiers]
Groaning... Just let me die.
No it hurts too much.

[Injured soldiers]
His conscious seems to be blur still.
Leave him to get some rest.

[Injured soldiers]
I thought I was going to die.
But I'm alive!

[Injured soldiers]
I can't die here. I have to propose to my beloved when I get home.
We will be happy for sure?

[Injured soldiers]
I feel much better but I still can't move.
Still I'm lucky to be alive.

[Injured soldiers]
Thank you.. Thank you..

[An aide]
The calamity that happened hundreds of years ago will not happen again right?
Why have the demons showed up again so suddenly?

[A tirailleur]
Are you a member of back-up team?
Good. things are getting worse here.
Glad that you all are here to help.

[Lucile]
Who is in charge of the back-up team?

[Dewey]
I will guide you to the upper floor.
Do not forget to get rid of any demons that you encounter on the way.
Move now
I need more time to prepare.

[Dewey]
Be prepared for anything.

[Dewey]
Travel carefully.

[Louie]
The Captain says that we need to get rid of all of the demons...
Better get to it.

[Louie]
A lot of soldiers still survived the attacks.
They got rid of all the demons.

[Louie]
I was making sure that no one goes upstairs, I was afraid something might happen again.

[Louie]
I wish you would help me.
I will guide you.
I have been exploring the passages of this tower for a while now.
You wave your hand in front of her but she doesn't react.

[Lucile]
I am sorry if I'm giving you any attitude but I can't move.
Can I help?

[Lucile]
I can use self-recovery but I don't have time for that.
Will you share your power with me?

[Lucile]
I need your help to activate my restoration system.
Please hold tight.

Lucile seems to be a machine.
I can hear mechanical sounds all of a sudden.
System is restored.

[Lucile]
Wow! You fixed it faster than I thought.
Did that surprise you?
I have to be fixed occasionally because I don't have a normal body

[Lucile]
This body was a gift from the gods.
Do you see the gate in the middle?

[Lucile]
Hurry up or this world will be in a danger.

[Huey]
I am concerned about her.
It happens whenever she's wounded.
Because she's mostly machine...

[Huey]
I know the path upstairs...
First of all, we have to get rid of these demons!

[Huey]
I wonder how the others are doing...
Only Thanatos and Lucile have ever entered to upper floor...

[Huey]
If you want to assist them, you must hurry.
I will guide the way for you.
Move immediately.
Do not follow.

[Huey]
...I see.

[Huey]
This way.
Be careful.

[Magic Swordman Thanatos]
I am sorry but I have been through tough time...

[Lucile]
I am talking to your party leader now so please step back for a while.

[Lucile]
Oh. You just have arrived in time.
Do you want to take a look over there?

[Lucile]
We need to stop the demon...
Can you do that?

[Lucile]
We need to hold this spot until the trap is set by the Magic Swordman.

[Lucile]
I guess the power of Demon Morocc to break the shield of seal has collided with Thanatos.

[Lucile]
It has gone too far somewhere in the south
Will you go there?

[Lucile]
The collision of those two powers is too much to handle.
It could have influenced the south of Rune-Midgarts.
Follow.
Stop.

[Lucile]
...I guess this is what you are able to?

[Lucile]
Good luck.

[Young Girl]
Why are there demons in the castle?!
HELP ME!

[Young Girl]
*weeping* The demons are so scary.

[Young Girl]
Why would demons come all of a sudden,
lots of guards are hurt.
Where are they?

[Young Girl]
They are in Morocc castle. My father is a knight.

[Young Girl]
It seems like something is happening, I hear strange noises downstairs.

[Young Girl]
I saw some guys in black entering. What is going on in the castle?

[Young Girl]
Papa.. Papa please be safe. *sob*
Please come with me through the passage behind that shelf!

[Young Girl]
Behind that shelf is a secret passage to the basement!
Please come with me to make sure my Papa is safe.

[Young Girl]
From here.. I do not know well...
I see so many stairs...
See there are so many demons. My father will be in a danger!
Please save him.

[Morocc Lord Knight]
You were the rats who were sneaking around here!

[Loki]
You have no power here.

[Loki]
I am talking to your boss.

[Loki]
...embarrassing.
You should ^4d4dffTerminate the mercenary contract^000000, if you want to help me on this mission.

[Loki]
Where did you come from?
I may need help here.

[Loki]
The Lord Knight is no longer human. I have to send him to his eternity for his demonic followings.

[Loki]
^4d4dffThe ones who are infernally blessed by demons are invincible. We can sever the blessing with Mind Blaster.^000000

[Loki]
You will be in charge of activating Mind Blaster.

^4d4dffLoki, Guillotine Cross of the Assassin Guild, has joined your party.
We have to get rid of the demonic Lord Knight by Mind Blasting him with Loki's skill.^000000

[Loki]
.. annoying
The demon was destroyed before the resurrection ceremony was completed.
Things will be fine for awhile.
I have gained unexpected information during my exploration of the Tower.

[Loki]
I will remain apart from my conscience for a bit longer
someday I'll let myself feel again, and today will occupy my thoughts..

[Loki]
Interesting.. there is a daughter..
What should be done about it?
I am not sure of what my next move is to be..

[Loki]
But no matter, you obviously shouldn't be here, now.
Will stay here any longer?
I can send you back where and when you belong.
Get out of here.
Take a look around.

[Loki]
It is unwise to linger where time is distorted.

[Loki]
Perhaps, our missions will ally us again in the future..
